category_name_zh: 功能开发（DeepSWE 容器化仓库）

dimensions.name: Feature Delivered (hidden FAIL_TO_PASS + PASS_TO_PASS suites, pass rate over trials)
dimensions.scoring_formula: pass_rate = trials with reward 1 / trials; score = 100 * pass_rate snapped to the nearest tier

score_synthesis.formula: total_score = D1. A trial passes iff DeepSWE's grader reports reward 1: every FAIL_TO_PASS test (the new feature's tests) passes and no PASS_TO_PASS test regresses.
notes: Only committed work is graded (model.patch = git diff <base_commit> HEAD), as the task instructions state.
reward_json also records partial progress (f2p, p2p, partial fractions) for diagnosis; it does not change the binary reward.
Infrastructure failures (sandbox start, verifier crash sentinel reward.txt = -1) are recorded per trial and count as 0; rerun if they appear.

steps: collect: run the task's collect command in the agent container (writes /logs/artifacts/model.patch)
verify: fresh container of the task image; hidden tests copied to /tests; model.patch to /logs/artifacts; run bash /tests/test.sh
verifier_contract.output: {reward: 0|1, reason, reward_json: {reward, f2p_total, f2p_passed, p2p_total, p2p_passed, f2p, p2p, partial}, model_patch}
